pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation using a food blender and passing through a 40-mesh screen to obtain a particle size of less than 0.425 mm.
Ensiling fresh Napier grass in a closed container under anaerobic conditions for 2 weeks to prepare Napier silage.
Organosolv pretreatment using 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol at 190 °C for 60 min in high-pressure stainless-steel vessels.
Chemical treatment during organosolv process using sodium hydroxide (1% w/w dry weight) as a catalyst for Napier grass or sulfuric acid (1% w/w) as a catalyst for Napier silage.
Hydrothermal pretreatment using distilled water at 190 °C for 60 min in high-pressure stainless-steel vessels.
Chemical treatment during hydrothermal process using sulfuric acid (1% w/w) as a catalyst.
